title: Ribbed Scrunchie
description: A quick wearable project made around a hair elastic with beginner-friendly repeats.
expectationText: A playful quick project where repetition builds confidence and the finished result feels giftable.

steps.title: Cover the elastic
steps.instruction: Join yarn around the hair elastic and single crochet evenly around it.

steps.title: Round 1
steps.instruction: Work enough single crochet around the elastic so the band is fully covered.

steps.title: Round 2
steps.instruction: Chain 2, then work half double crochet into each stitch around.

steps.title: Round 3
steps.instruction: Work one more round of half double crochet for a fuller scrunchie.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Slip stitch to join, fasten off, and weave the tail inside the folds.
